USCSS MERIDIAN — EMERGENCY PROTOCOLS REV. 3

1. FIRE
   - Activate suppression via Bridge panel A1.
   - Evacuate affected sector. Seal bulkheads.

2. HULL BREACH
   - Emergency seal kits located in B4 Security and C1 Engineering.
   - Do not attempt repair without environment suit.

3. MEDICAL EMERGENCY
   - Report to Medbay B3.
   - If B3 unavailable: apply emergency kit (every crew locker).

4. HOSTILE CONTACT
   - Hostile contact is defined in Appendix A.
   - Lock down affected sector. Contact Security Office B4.
   - Do NOT engage without authorization.

5. BIOLOGICAL HAZARD
   - Follow Section 7 of crew handbook.
   - Quarantine: Bay C2 isolation cells.
   - Notify Officer Verlaine immediately.

[Seegson note: This document does not supersede W-Y priority directives.]
